name: The Wild West
heading: Video games set in the Wild West
intro: The American frontier west of the Mississippi from the 1840s to 1900: the overland trails, the gold rushes, cattle trails, railroads and frontier towns.

name: America in the 1800s
heading: Video games set in 19th-century America
intro: North America from 1800 to 1900, from the overland trails and the gold rush to the cities of the Gilded Age.

name: America in the 1920s and early 1930s
heading: Video games set in 1920s America
intro: The United States from 1920 to 1933: Prohibition, organised crime, jazz and the first years of the Depression.

name: Victorian London
heading: Video games set in Victorian London
intro: London under Queen Victoria, from 1837 to 1901: gaslight, fog, Whitechapel and the largest city in the world.

name: Imperial Japan
heading: Video games set in Imperial Japan
intro: Japan from the Meiji Restoration in 1868 to the end of the Second World War in 1945, and the islands of the Pacific war.

name: Samurai-era Japan
heading: Video games set in samurai-era Japan
intro: Japan from the Kamakura shogunate in 1185 to the end of the Edo period in 1867, the age of the samurai.

name: World War II in Europe
heading: Video games set in World War II in Europe
intro: The war in Europe and the Mediterranean from 1939 to 1945, from Normandy and Arnhem to the Eastern Front and Berlin.

name: World War II in the Pacific
heading: Video games set in World War II in the Pacific
intro: The Pacific and Asian theatre from 1939 to 1945, from Wake Island and Guadalcanal to Iwo Jima and Okinawa.

name: Ancient Egypt
heading: Video games set in ancient Egypt
intro: The land of the pharaohs and the Ptolemies, from the first dynasties to the end of Roman rule.
